title: Ends: God, self, neighbor; necessity of good works
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): On necessity: good works stand as not necessary toward justification as a cause, but stand as necessary in ye justified as fruit and ye Christian way belonging toward life—against those who thrust them into justification itself. — Ends: toward God—obedience and honor; toward ourselves—confirming our calling; toward ye neighbor—relieving by love's duties and avoiding scandal.
pass_b_english: Ends: toward God—obedience and honor; toward ourselves—confirming our calling; toward the neighbor—relieving by love's duties and avoiding scandal.

On necessity: good works are not necessary to justification as a cause, but are necessary in the justified as fruit and the Christian way of life—against those who thrust them into justification itself.
source_text: Fines: propter Deum obedientia et honor; propter nos ipsos ut vocationem confirmemus; propter proximum ut charitatis officiis sublevemus nec scandala simus. De necessitate: bona opera non sunt necessaria ad iustificationem tanquam causa, sed necessaria sunt in iustificatis tanquam fructus et via vitae Christianae—contra Pontificios qui ea in iustificationem ingerunt.
